title: stipa pulcherrima var. mollis
intro: Stipa pulcherrima var. mollis, commonly known as Velvet grass or Soft feather grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Velvet grass include anti-inflammatory and expectorant effects, which can help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Velvet grass include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
